newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria buys 13,000T raw sugar at $338, cancels rest.
newsitem.headline: Syria buys 13,000T raw sugar at $338, cancels rest.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs (GEZA) has bought 13,000 tonnes for raw sugar for October delivery at $388, a senior GEZA official said on Friday.
He told Reuters that the sugar was bought from Cargill.
He added Geza had cancelled the purchase of 13,000 tonnes of raws and 26,000 tonnes of white sugar which were contained in the same tender issued on August 29.
